_comment: One per workspace root, written by /workspace, never hand-edited except through /workspace's own re-run (adding/removing a repo) or a task's own plan touching contracts/registry entries under human approval. Stack-blind: this file names repos, paths, and contracts — never a language or tool. The three hooks (phase-gate, path-escalate, dep-gate) read this file to route by target path; its absence at $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR is exactly how a hook tells 'plain single-repo project' from 'workspace root' and falls back to pre-Extension-B behavior unchanged.

repos._comment: One entry per member repo. `path` is absolute — this is what additionalDirectories in .claude/settings.json also lists, and what the hooks longest-prefix-match an edited file's absolute path against. `role` is free text for humans (producer/consumer/both) — nothing mechanical reads it; the contract registry below is what actually encodes producer/consumer direction.
repos.name: <repo-name>

contracts._comment: One entry per declared cross-repo contract. `spec_path` is workspace-root-relative, always under contracts/<name>/ — contract-touch classifies additive/breaking straight from `git diff` against this path, so nothing here needs to track its own drift signal separately. `producer_paths` are globs relative to the producer repo's own root — the files whose change means the producer's real implementation of this contract moved, consulted by contract-touch alongside spec_path itself. `producer_paths_match_count` is a mechanical staleness proxy: the count of real files matching producer_paths at the time this entry was last confirmed accurate; if a later contract-touch run finds that count has dropped to zero, the registry is very likely stale (the producer refactored those paths away without updating this entry) and contract-touch says so loudly rather than silently under-detecting blast radius.
contracts.name: <contract-name>
